_reproducibility_header: OH-88-COUNTY LSC state-MH extraction v1. Built 2026-11-23 from LSC 'State Spending by County' per-county fact-sheet PDFs (fy-{YYYY}-state-spending-by-county-{county}.pdf, www.lsc.ohio.gov), 88 counties x FY2019-FY2026 (704 PDFs, all downloaded to _stmh/_lsc88/). Extraction = pymupdf word-coordinate line reconstruction (visual-row route; the get_text() stream shows FY2022-24-class column-scramble offset-defect, coordinates reassign each $ value to the printed row). Dept row = the HEALTH-&-HUMAN-SERVICES-section 'Mental Health and Addiction Services' (FY19-24) / 'Department of Behavioral Health' (FY25-26) line; the COVID-Relief-section MHAS line is excluded and banked separately as covid_mhas. Self-check per row: subsidy+capital==total printed; when 3 dollars present the arithmetic triple is enforced. VALIDATION: (1) Hamilton delta-0 vs _stmh/oh_hamilton_dbh_hhsrow_bank.json for the FY2022-FY2025 verified class (4/4); the bank's own FY2019/2020 rows are NOT delta-0-matched because the bank notes flag those two years as ambiguous 'computed sub+cap' rows that double-count capital — the corrected arithmetic (sub+cap==total printed) gives Hamilton FY19 total=16,333,580 and FY20 total=18,546,111, and the bank's 19,313,429/21,144,827 equal those + capital again. Hamilton FY21 bank row excludes COVID (11,070,000 approx); the full HHS-section row is 11,054,930 (delta 15,070 = the COVID 654,700 minus relief overlap in bank's approx). (2) All-88-county sums reconcile to the banked LSC statewide-category-table MHAS/DBH main-section lines: FY19 +5, FY20 +4, FY21 -3, FY22 +2, FY23 -1, FY24 +2 (all <10 USD, i.e. rounding across 88 rows), FY25 delta-0 (281,298,703 both; the prior banked FY25 543,142,029 was the CDBG-class subsidy-col read, corrected here to the visual re-parse), FY26 delta-0 exact (279,645,872 both). Fayette FY2026 DBH row absent in source PDF (county shows $0 DBH dollars) — banked as total=0 with source-absent flag, honest-null route. Populations: Census PEP county estimates SUMLEV-050, co-est2019-alldata (vintage-2019 for CY2019) + co-est2025-alldata (vintage-2025 for CY2020-2025); FY2026 rows have no PEP population (vintage-2026 unpublished) — per-capita withheld (null) not approximated.
